$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:track_tier reading for requirement lines. Param is a track id and a tier id joined by a slash (Your_Mining/Adept); the reading is 1 once the best level the player ever reached is at or above that tier's first level on the track's curve, and 0 below it. Write Min 1 to require the tier. A track that names itself words its lock lines ('Requires Adept in Mining'). It changes only through the player's own track gains or a track reload (Volatility Player).
